articles.headline: India Postpones UPI Payment Fee Until After Diwali
articles.brief: The Indian government has officially delayed the rollout of planned UPI payment processing fees until the conclusion of the Diwali festival season, providing temporary relief to digital consumers and merchants alike.

articles.headline: IMF Highlights India's Robust Economic Growth Trajectory
articles.brief: In a bullish global assessment, the International Monetary Fund highlighted India's impressive growth metrics, describing the nation as a resilient sprinting force amid wider global economic stumbling.

articles.headline: Nvidia Acquires Stakes in French Tech Startups
articles.brief: Semiconductor giant Nvidia has expanded its European footprint by securing strategic financial stakes in prominent French tech startups Doctolib and Genesis AI to bolster AI development.

articles.headline: US Department of Energy Declares Grid Emergency in 13 States
articles.brief: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright issued a power grid emergency declaration across 13 states, empowering PJM Interconnection to actively manage generation units amid surging electricity demands.

articles.headline: Pope Leo XIV Undergoes Successful Lung Cancer Surgery
articles.brief: The Vatican confirmed that 71-year-old Pope Leo XIV successfully underwent surgery to remove the lower lobe of his right lung after being diagnosed with lung cancer, and is currently recovering.

articles.headline: India Confronts Growing Overtreatment and Overmedication Crisis
articles.brief: Medical experts across India are raising alarms regarding a pervasive rise in unnecessary clinical tests, pharmaceutical prescriptions, and surgical procedures contributing to systemic healthcare strain.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Stays Trial Against Rahul Gandhi Over Remarks
articles.brief: The Supreme Court of India granted a significant legal reprieve by staying trial proceedings against opposition leader Rahul Gandhi in connection with political remarks made during past campaigns.

articles.headline: India and Canada Advance Bilateral Ties and Trade Talks
articles.brief: Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney to advance strategic cooperation across energy, security, and trade ahead of Foreign Minister Anita Anand's visit.

articles.headline: Hyundai Motor Group Announces $15.5 Billion Investment in India
articles.brief: Hyundai Motor Group has committed a massive $15.5 billion capital injection into India's growing automotive sector, aiming to significantly scale up local manufacturing capabilities and electric vehicle infrastructure.

articles.headline: Shell Agrees to Sell Nigerian Gas Business to Vaaris Energy
articles.brief: Energy giant Shell has taken steps to divest its commercial gas business operations in Nigeria, reaching a definitive sales agreement with buyer Vaaris Energy as part of ongoing regional portfolio restructurings.

articles.headline: Two Commercial Ships Struck by Projectiles in Strait of Hormuz
articles.brief: Maritime security agencies reported that two commercial cargo vessels sustained direct hits from unidentified projectiles while navigating through the critical shipping chokepoint of the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.headline: India Issues Urgent Safety Advisory for Citizens in Saudi Arabia
articles.brief: Following recent regional missile and drone strikes near Riyadh, the Indian government issued an urgent advisory urging its expatriate nationals in Saudi Arabia to stay indoors and exercise caution.

articles.headline: Boat Capsizes in Bihar's Vaishali District, Multiple Casualties Reported
articles.brief: A tragic boating accident on the Ganges River in Bihar's Vaishali district left over a dozen children dead and several others missing, prompting immediate state rescue and relief operations.

articles.headline: Hamstring Injury Rules Cricketer Mhatre Out for Six Weeks
articles.brief: Promising domestic cricketer Mhatre has been officially sidelined from competitive play for six weeks following a severe hamstring injury sustained during a Ranji Trophy opening match against Chandigarh.
